name: Notebook
style: Loose blue-ink pen sketch on a page of college-ruled notebook paper with pale blue rules and a row of punched holes down the left edge, quick lively outlines with a little scribbled shading and the odd stray construction line left in. A green felt-tip accent is used ONLY on the main character's scarf and on one or two tiny details per scene; everything else is blue ink on the white page. Supporting people are sketched in the same blue ink with ordinary proportions, oval faces, a nose, proper eyes with lids and their own hair and clothes, never the main character's bean-shaped head or button eyes, and never in green. Anyone who appears in more than one scene keeps the same hair, clothes and build; phones, cars, furniture and fashion fit the time the story is set in. Figures stay separate and never overlap or blend into each other, the same people who walk into a diagram walk out of it, and charts or size comparisons keep exactly the proportions the narration gives.
character: The main character (Sprout) must match the attached character sheet exactly: tall bean-shaped head with a single curl of hair on top, two button eyes, a small open smile, green striped scarf, plain long-sleeved shirt, cargo shorts, high-top shoes.
